notes.title: Steam Workshop update! Empires Shall Fall - Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
Patch 1.2.0:
- Added Steam Workshop support. Now you can share and download custom maps!
- Added Best Score for campaign.
- Added name of the mission in victory screen.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 and 1.1.2
notes.content:
Patch 1.1.1:
Some of the Japanese translations have been improved

Patch 1.1.2:
Corrected some honorific expressions in the Japanese dialogues

notes.title: Empires Shall Fall - Patch 1.1.0 - New Languages, Bug Fixes, New Skirmish Maps!
notes.content:
Patch 1.1.0:
- Added new languages: French, Latin American Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish
- Chinese and Japanese translations have been completely redone
- Added 4 new skirmish maps: Short Battle (by Captain Kran), Swamp Valley (by Captain Kran), Mega City (by Cheshire Kotovsky), Depot
- When using CO Power, a description is now displayed at the bottom
- Restart and Main Menu buttons now require confirmation
- Right-click now works as a cancel button in all UI windows
- Cancel button is now displayed at the bottom of the screen
- Victory at Great Cost achievement was changed: Complete a mission with "30" or more units lost
- Fixed a bug where units could not attack after merging
- Empire's 3rd mission: fixed city's tiles
- Fixed a bug where sounds played even if they were muted

The game has a 20% discount on Steam due update!

notes.title: Empires Shall Fall Developer Livestream!
notes.content:
Join us at our Steam page stream! We'll be streaming our game.
